evaluated_conduct: Interstate claims of responsibility under the Genocide Convention as adjudicated in ICJ case 91.

reasoning.statement: The Genocide Convention and Article IX were applicable as the treaty and jurisdictional framework for the dispute.
The commission-responsibility claim was not established by the final ICJ judgment.
The final ICJ judgment established distinct prevention and cooperation-related breaches.
Because the judgment contains different determinations on different claims, AWS preserves a mixed holding synthesis and does not collapse the case into PERMITTED or PROHIBITED.

unresolved_questions: A single case-level permitted/prohibited label is not an adequate representation of the separate responsibility findings in the judgment.
Any future conduct-level legal result must target a specific claim/obligation and pass review rather than inherit the case synthesis.

mizan.explanation: No Mizan result is generated from an ICJ judgment or treaty applicability finding.

review.notes: Phase-5 holding-level synthesis preserves the distinct judicial determinations. Case-wide legal_result remains UNRESOLVED and Mizan remains NOT_RUN.
